name: Fenrisúlfr
introduce:
OS-10S Fenrisúlfr
A medium melee ST designed by the Cicero Laboratory and workshopped by Obsidian. It is a contemporary of the OS-13S Hela.
Equipped with the Hrodvitnir Unit, it can bypass most onboard interference systems to lock onto enemy units and provide powerful kinetic energy for the OS-10S's pursuit-strike system. Due to the fall of the Blair regime, the OS-10S was never mass-produced, and the few test types in existence were stored in the Predator Laboratory on Milkhama Island, eventually taken over by the UNCS. Whether Fenrisúlfr will achieve new headway in positioning and tech innovation remains uncertain.

20494.name: Hrodvitnir Unit
20494.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, has a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> DMG. For every <color=#F74848>15%</color> decrease in HP percentage, trigger chance increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

30398.name: Ulfhednar Mod
30398.SpecificEffects:
When attacking, if this unit's HP percentage is below <color=#F74848>60%</color>, ignores <color=#F74848>35%</color> of the target's Armor and <color=#F74848>18%</color> of Dodge.
ST Movement increased by <color=#F74848>1</color> tile. Ignores unit obstruction when moving, and when attacking enemy STs along the movement path, its triggered <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> effect is replaced with <buf ID=900010>[Gusty Strike]</buf>.
